mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_type (hotel_id, name, description, capacity, bed_type, base_price, total_rooms, status) VALUES (#{hotelId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{capacity}, #{bedType}, #{basePrice}, #{totalRooms}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE room_type SET hotel_id=#{hotelId}, name=#{name}, description=#{description}, capacity=#{capacity}, bed_type=#{bedType}, base_price=#{basePrice}, total_rooms=#{totalRooms}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM room_type WHERE hotel_id=#{hotelId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
